sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: Roomie-Homie (“we”, “our”, or “us”) operates the Roomie-Homie mobile application (“App”). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect
sections.content:
We collect the following when you sign in using Google Authentication:
• Name
• Email
• Profile Photo
• Google UID

Additionally, any data you voluntarily provide in the app (such as profile details, preferences, or app-generated data) may be securely stored in Firebase Firestore or Firebase Realtime Database.

We DO NOT collect:
• Phone number
• Location
• Device identifiers
• Payment information
• Any unnecessary personal data

sections.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
sections.content:
We use your Google-provided information solely for:
• Secure authentication
• Displaying your profile
• Maintaining your account

We DO NOT use your data for ads or tracking.

sections.title: 4. Data Sharing & Disclosure
sections.content:
We DO NOT sell your data. It is shared only with:
• Google/Firebase (authentication)
• Legal authorities (if required)

sections.title: 5. Data Security
sections.content:
We use Firebase Authentication, Firestore, and Firebase Realtime Database to store and manage data. These services use industry-standard security including encrypted connections (HTTPS) and secure Google-managed infrastructure.

While we take reasonable steps to protect your information, no method of electronic storage or transmission is 100% secure.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
sections.content: Your profile data is kept only while your account is active and deleted automatically when removed from Google/Firebase.

sections.title: 7. Children’s Privacy
sections.content: Roomie-Homie (“App”) is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

sections.title: 8. Your Rights
sections.content: You may request access, deletion, or correction of your data by contacting: nathsai055+dev@gmail.com, Subject must me 'Roomie Homie account related query'.

sections.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy at any time.

sections.title: 10. Contact Us
sections.content: For any questions please email us: nathsai055+dev@gmail.com
